references.text: Gideon is first mentioned at the oak tree, and here his military campaign that began with his calling continues.
Gideon and his men pursue the Midianites, and this verse continues this pursuit toward their camp.
Nobah is mentioned as a place that was conquered and named after its conqueror, the same place mentioned in Gideon's campaign.
The expression 'betach' (in safety) is used here in a similar way to describe a camp that felt secure before a surprise attack.
A reference to living in safety in the land, contrasting with the Midianites' false sense of security.
Nomadic peoples who live in tents are mentioned, similar to the description of those living in tents whom Gideon attacked.
